description:
Position: .Net Developer 
 Location: Coppell TX 
 Duration: 6+ Month Contract 
 
 This is for our Healthcare domain client in Coppell TX, candidate must have Hippa/SOX experience / . Market rate. 
 
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 
 · Develop modules for win/web applications and integration tiers using .NET technologies (e.g., Visual Basic, C# and ASP.Net, MS Office, VBA) and third-party objects. 
 · Write and review technical specifications based on technical requirements and functional specifications. 
 · Contribute to development and publication of release documentation and the development of code to facilitate the migration and conversion of data. 
 · Assist with select quality assurance tasks, including test data preparation, defect root cause analysis and production support 
 · Work within multiple software development life cycle (SDLC) models including Waterfall and Agile. 
 · Adhere to all HIPAA and SOX software development compliance policies and procedures. 
 · Other duties and responsibilities as assigned including but not limited to: 
 Attend team meetings, phone conferences, and training as needed. 
 Know, understand, and follow teammate guidelines, employment policies, and department or company procedures. 
 
 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Required 
 • 0-3 years’ experience in application development and support using .NET technologies (e.g., Visual Basic, C#, ASP.Net, MS Office, VBA), third-party objects and other similar technologies.
• Experience in application development leveraging relational and OLTP database technologies such as Oracle 10g, SQL Server and MySQL.
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or related discipline.
